work_completed: Root-caused the flat/black sky in OpenWorld_Level to a sign-inverted sun direction override in UNLTAtmosphereSubsystem::FindOrCreateSkyAtmosphere: OverrideAtmosphereLightDirection(0, GetSunDirection()) passes the light's TRAVEL direction where the engine expects the direction TOWARD the sun, parking the atmosphere sun 37.5 degrees below the horizon so transmittance to the sun is zero.
Removed the override call. The engine default (-Light->GetDirection()) is already correct, tracks the light, and cannot go stale if bAutoAdvanceTime is later enabled.

Documented an engine quirk: USkyAtmosphereComponent::ResetAtmosphereLightDirectionOverride (SkyAtmosphereComponent.cpp:423) never calls MarkRenderStateDirty(), while OverrideAtmosphereLightDirection (:381) does. A runtime reset alone is a silent no-op on the render proxy; a component reregister is required to apply it live.

MASS-001 root cause confirmed: UNLTScenarioMovementProcessor::Execute calls Context.GetFragmentView<FNLTStateTreeBehaviorFragment>() at NLTDemoScenarioProcessors.cpp:247, BEFORE EntityQuery.ForEachEntityChunk. FMassExecutionContext::FragmentViews is only populated by ApplyFragmentRequirements(), which asserts check(IsCurrentQuery(...)) and is only reachable while a query executes; the query clears the views on pop (MassEntityQuery.cpp:391/487). Outside a chunk the array is always empty, so FindByPredicate returns null and MASS_CHECK_IF_VALID fires. Structural, not a race - the call could never have worked. NOTE: The fix (moving both reads inside the lambda, capture reduced to [Dt], matching the sibling UNLTScenarioDecisionProcessor at line 183) was NOT applied to the source. The code at line 247 still calls GetFragmentView outside ForEachEntityChunk. This remains an open defect.
